fix.whatSomeoneCouldDo: Pay for one route and use that payment to get a different route with the same price, or use one payment across many routes.
escalation: The severity could rise to high if routes with the same price give access to content of different value.
fix.summary: Make each payment usable only on the route it was made for.
steps: Give each paid route its own payment address, so a payment's recipient shows which route it was for. It is not part of the x402 specification, and whether official guidance recommends it has not been checked.
Before sending content, check that the payment's recipient is the address of the route being requested.
Keep the route-to-address list in one place, and check it when your service starts.
fix.guidance: General guidance. It has not been tested on your service.
notAFix: Different prices alone. Two routes with the same price still accept each other's payments.

coverage: This report covers only the manifest given. Nothing was sent to any server, and routes or settings that the manifest does not hold were not looked at.
